Proves the complete unchanged SP-12 target: for every positive-order finite simple graph, a real symmetric matrix with exactly its off-diagonal nonzero pattern, a nonnegative quadratic form, the Strong Arnold property and nullity at least its actual chromatic number minus one. Isolated vertices, disconnected graphs and the singleton are included; no realization, degree, genericity or analytic premise remains.

The proof reuses the exact SP-11 shared-variable polynomial construction and proves real predecessor independence and Gram SAP. The actual nonedge Gram derivative is surjective by an SAP duality argument. Neighborhood-image surjectivity and openness on a fixed graph test space give an actual one-vertex extension with exact nonedge cancellation. Low-degree deletion preserves the actual chromatic number; finite induction and the Gram rank bound complete the frozen Target.

The self-contained canonical package has 51 exact copied modules (36 SP-11 proofs, 12 new SP-12 proofs and three statement modules), separately frozen Reviewed/Challenge/Identity, pinned dependencies and source locks. Two independent fresh statement reviews and two canonical boundary approvals preceded Solution. Two final fidelity reviews check the full export, copies, metadata and attribution with explicit author exclusions. Hall retains mathematical credit; Stepaniants authored the retained application note. Formalization/review are AI-agent work.

Validation: all 51 source builds and the independent full Target consumer passed (52 commands), with 377 declaration audits, 268 theorem-kind checks including the actual private helper, LeanCert kernel trust and only the standard three axioms. Shared Final and canonical Solution also passed separate independent direct compiles. Manifest/Comparator coverage, all 217 permanent IDs, 17 ID tests and byte preservation of all 217 canonical pages plus 611 original artifacts pass. The shared CI aggregate imports the complete new proof. The independent canonical build passed all 55 sources plus its consumer (56 commands, 379 declarations, 270 theorem-kind checks). Actual [Linux run 39142969327](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/actions/runs/39142969327) passed the real isolated Comparator, default kernel, LeanCert kernel and rejection/sandbox controls. Its retained original artifact independently passes all 40 audit checks and all 96 committed/current input hashes. SP-12 is promoted to Lean verified, with its exact original README/TeX/PDF archived, all original text and history recoverable, and all 55 checked Lean inputs unchanged. The promotion passed two independent preservation reviews and final three-page PDF visual QA. The promoted package also passed refreshed [Linux run 39149417211](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/actions/runs/39149417211) at `a7adfc8e`, with a separate independent 40-check/96-input artifact audit. All 55 checked Lean inputs and the exact 96-file input set match both real runs; only README and formalization metadata changed between them. Both original artifacts and receipts are retained.

Stacked on SP-11 #361 so this PR's diff is limited to SP-12. The first complete proof commit is `529e7b0560cef6461c98e950046860a160e6f86c`. The broader Solved-proof goal remains active and incomplete.

Regenerated catalogs now report 81 Lean verified and 37 Solved entries, with all 217 permanent IDs/paths unchanged. TR-14 is the next active proof development; no claim is made that its remaining substantive gates are already proved.

For every complex Hankel tensor of order m≥3 and dimension n≥2, the complete unchanged Lean Target now proves equivalence of ordinary and symmetric decompositions at every natural width. This includes zero and exceptional data and arbitrary mode-dependent ordinary factors.

The proof constructs both symmetric upper bounds and the unrestricted ordinary lower bound in one actual normalized least-apolar chart. The lower argument constructs actual graph spaces, separate graph units, reduced primitive blocks, quotient mode dimensions, whole-local-factor supports and dimension partitions. Actual chart transport and zero padding finish the original-coordinate all-width equivalence.

The canonical package exports only `NLA.TR14.target : NLA.Statements.TR14.Target`, uses LeanCert kernel trust and permits only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. It contains 78 exact shared source copies and 82 actual Lean inputs. Two independent boundary approvals preceded Solution; source reviews distinguish authorship from independent checking.

PF-05 now has a complete Lean proof of its unchanged equivalence: for every real rank-three, PSD-rank-two matrix and every fixed size-two PSD factorization, actual common-interval straight-line infinitesimal rigidity is equivalent to uniqueness up to one shared invertible congruence. All zero patterns, zero factors, singular factors and repeated positive rays are included. The selected canonical export is `NLA.PF05.target`, with no added proof premise or replaceable definition hole.

The proof integrates arbitrary feasible directions for the reverse implication. The forward proof uses the actual nonzero zero-pair normal form, a direct signed-quartic/conic argument for positive data, and proved zero-factor deletion/restoration. Seven retained candidate modules remain byte-identical. All 217 permanent IDs and canonical paths are preserved. Only the marked PF-05 status/verification notice and regenerated TeX/PDF change; the full original Markdown is recovered byte for byte after removing that notice/restoring status and date. Five original canonical/submitted-proof artifacts are archived with hashes. Source credit and historical text are retained.

Validation: independent full shared rebuild passes 43 commands; independent canonical rebuild passes all 47 commands for 46 actual Lean inputs, 384 named constants and 299 theorem-kind checks, including private constants and named local instances. The literal unchanged Target passes LeanCert kernel trust with only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`. Two independent canonical boundary approvals preceded Solution; exact-copy/delta reviews pass. The required permanent-ID workflow validates 217 IDs and all 17 tests. Manifest/Comparator coverage and the retained-base statement inventory validate.

Actual exact-source Linux push run [39172661343](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/actions/runs/39172661343), job 117816715607, succeeded at proof commit 10e71f134795c6cb94ab90edf2a8deef0f4722fe. Both strict offline artifact replays pass all 41 controls, all 90 inputs and all 46 Lean sources, including Comparator, default kernel, LeanCert kernel mode and rejection/isolation controls. Raw artifact ZIP, metadata and logs are retained. Synthetic PR-merge commit identity failures are retained and labeled separately.

PF-05 is now Lean verified with `whole_problem_verified: true`; independent promotion review passes all 18 preservation controls, unchanged 45-record statement validator, full original text/TeX restoration and clean two-page PDF QA. The catalog now has 83 Lean-verified and 35 Solved entries. All 46 checked Lean inputs remain unchanged. The descriptive package promotion at c4c7be59 requires fresh actual Linux CI, currently pending; the proof-commit receipt is not relabeled as a receipt for these later descriptions. This PR is stacked on the TR-14 proof branch. Reviews are independent AI-agent reviews, with author exclusions stated explicitly; no external human endorsement is claimed.
